description: Answer founder questions from 1984 Ventures' public Founders Handbook, with a link to the chapter behind every answer. Use for picking a startup idea, choosing or parting ways with a co-founder, cap tables, dilution and option pools, SAFEs (pre vs post-money, SAFE vs priced round, side letters, conversion math), monthly investor updates, Series A decks and Series A dilution, secondaries, structured or down rounds, selling the company (M&A process, legal prep, deal structure, deal terms), QSBS, seed-stage engineering practices, and open source content marketing or telemetry.
